notes: Unfocused offscreen skip-link is hidden only during capture to prevent known Chromium full-section capture artifact; no source or persistent DOM changes.
Reduced-motion context preserves final static counter values and avoids automatic video previews.
Bounds cover all visible section/card/grid/list elements, while screenshots cover every complete section through native locator capture.

layoutFindings.before: Facts had a redundant 24px inner inset; five desktop facts occupied four columns, leaving a sparse second row. Intro spacing had no native wrapper.
layoutFindings.after: Native oj-section-intro, oj-grid and oj-stack align unchanged facts with the container; 1/3/5 columns at 390/768/1440 with 16px gaps.

layoutFindings.before: Obsolete section wrappers lacked native outer spacing.
layoutFindings.after: Root changed the two unchanged raw-content wrappers to oj-hero and oj-section. Hero padding is 32px / 46.08px / 86.4px at the three widths.

layoutFindings.before: Middle desktop CTA sat one text line below its neighbors despite equal card heights.
layoutFindings.after: Root grouped the unchanged article links in native oj-card-actions; all three desktop CTAs now share the same baseline and bottom spacing.

layoutFindings.before: Four data-research panels touched with 0px gap at all three widths.
layoutFindings.after: Root added native oj-stack to the unchanged list wrapper. Independent targeted follow-up measured all three real gaps as exactly 16px at 390/768/1440; screenshots were visually inspected.

layoutFindings.before: All legal-condition heading and paragraph blocks touched without external vertical spacing; the existing prose wrapper lacked a native stack.
layoutFindings.after: Root added only native oj-stack to the existing wrapper. All 58 heading/paragraph/list blocks have at least 16px external gaps at 390/768/1440; existing native list margins produce 30px at list boundaries. All three complete terms screenshots visually inspected; no overflow. Typography, text, media, URLs and colors remain unchanged.

visualReview.scope: Full visible page sections, responsive rows/cards/lists, alignment and spacing. Baseline images plus corresponding final captures and targeted corrected sections were inspected.
visualReview.unrelatedChanges: No editorial text, image/video attributes, URLs or colors changed in the agent-owned corrections.
limitations: External YouTube embed content is network dependent; its responsive frame and local fallback link were visually checked, but playback was outside this layout-only review.
Header/footer and shared styles are owned and independently reviewed by root.
